title: Tracking event
description: One carrier scan against a shipment, normalized into acme's status vocabulary.

shipment-id.description: Shipment this scan belongs to, resolved by the gateway from the tracking number.

tracking-number.description: Carrier reference the scan arrived against, kept for support and for replay.

carrier.description: Carrier that produced the scan, as the gateway names it.

status.description: Acme's closed vocabulary. Every consumer branches on this and never on the raw code.

carrier-status-code.description: The carrier's own code, verbatim. Kept so a wrong mapping stays diagnosable.

occurred-at.description: When the courier scanned, normalized to UTC. What the customer is ever shown.

recorded-at.description: When acme received the scan. Its distance from occurred-at is acme's own latency.

attempt-number.description: Which delivery attempt this was. Present only on delivery-attempted and delivered.

location.description: Coarse place of the scan. Never a full address — see the entity document.

courier-note.description: Free text from the handheld, e.g. left with neighbour. Third-party text, treated as opaque.

place.description: Sorting-hub granularity: enough to draw a route, not enough to identify a person.
